title.pinyin: Zǒu shí fēnzhōng jiù dào le

instruction.hanzi: 读一读，说说这些词语是什么意思。
instruction.english: Read the words and phrases aloud and say what they mean.

items.english: far from school
to walk, to go on foot
to take the bus
to go to the airport
one hour
too slow
a bit faster
to get to the classroom

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 马克，你家离学校远吗？
dialogue.pinyin: Mǎkè, nǐ jiā lí xuéxiào yuǎn ma?
dialogue.english: Mark, is your place far from school?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 不远，走十分钟就到了。你呢？
dialogue.pinyin: Bù yuǎn, zǒu shí fēnzhōng jiù dào le. Nǐ ne?
dialogue.english: No, it's just a ten-minute walk. What about you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 我家离学校很远，我每天六点就起床了。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào hěn yuǎn, wǒ měi tiān liù diǎn jiù qǐ chuáng le.
dialogue.english: Mine is a long way from school. I'm up by six every day.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 六点？太早了！
dialogue.pinyin: Liù diǎn? Tài zǎo le!
dialogue.english: Six? That's so early!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 所以我每天七点五十就到教室了。
dialogue.pinyin: Suǒyǐ wǒ měi tiān qī diǎn wǔshí jiù dào jiàoshì le.
dialogue.english: That's why I'm already in the classroom at 7:50 every day.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 那时候教室里没有人吧？
dialogue.pinyin: Nà shíhou jiàoshì li méiyǒu rén ba?
dialogue.english: There's nobody in the classroom at that time, right?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 对，我很喜欢在这儿看书。
dialogue.pinyin: Duì, wǒ hěn xǐhuan zài zhèr kàn shū.
dialogue.english: Right. I really like reading here.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 王明，你去哪儿？
dialogue.pinyin: Wáng Míng, nǐ qù nǎr?
dialogue.english: Wang Ming, where are you off to?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 我去我姐姐的公司，给她送一本书。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ qù wǒ jiějie de gōngsī, gěi tā sòng yì běn shū.
dialogue.english: To my sister's company, to drop off a book for her.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 她的公司离这儿远不远？
dialogue.pinyin: Tā de gōngsī lí zhèr yuǎn bu yuǎn?
dialogue.english: Is her company far from here?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 不太远，坐公共汽车二十分钟就到了。
dialogue.pinyin: Bú tài yuǎn, zuò gōnggòng qìchē èrshí fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
dialogue.english: Not too far. It's only twenty minutes by bus.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 现在公共汽车慢不慢？
dialogue.pinyin: Xiànzài gōnggòng qìchē màn bu màn?
dialogue.english: Are the buses slow right now?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 还可以，不太慢。
dialogue.pinyin: Hái kěyǐ, bú tài màn.
dialogue.english: They're OK, not too slow.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 我也去那儿，我们一起走吧！
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yě qù nàr, wǒmen yìqǐ zǒu ba!
dialogue.english: I'm going that way too. Let's go together!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 先生，我去机场。
dialogue.pinyin: Xiānsheng, wǒ qù jīchǎng.
dialogue.english: To the airport, please.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 好。你是几点的飞机？
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo. Nǐ shì jǐ diǎn de fēijī?
dialogue.english: Sure. What time is your flight?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 十一点的。现在离机场还很远吗？
dialogue.pinyin: Shíyī diǎn de. Xiànzài lí jīchǎng hái hěn yuǎn ma?
dialogue.english: Eleven. Is the airport still far from here?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 还很远呢，要一个小时。
dialogue.pinyin: Hái hěn yuǎn ne, yào yí ge xiǎoshí.
dialogue.english: Still quite far. It'll take an hour.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 一个小时？您能开快一点儿吗？
dialogue.pinyin: Yí ge xiǎoshí? Nín néng kāi kuài yìdiǎnr ma?
dialogue.english: An hour? Could you drive a bit faster?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 好，我开快一点儿。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ kāi kuài yìdiǎnr.
dialogue.english: OK, I'll go a little faster.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 谢谢您！
dialogue.pinyin: Xièxie nín!
dialogue.english: Thank you!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 今天上午，我去机场接妈妈。
dialogue.pinyin: Jīntiān shàngwǔ, wǒ qù jīchǎng jiē māma.
dialogue.english: This morning I went to the airport to meet my mother.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 她的飞机十点到，我八点就出门了。
dialogue.pinyin: Tā de fēijī shí diǎn dào, wǒ bā diǎn jiù chū mén le.
dialogue.english: Her plane was landing at ten, so I left home as early as eight.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 路上车非常多，出租车很慢。
dialogue.pinyin: Lù shang chē fēicháng duō, chūzūchē hěn màn.
dialogue.english: There was a lot of traffic on the road, and the taxi was very slow.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 过了一个小时，我还在车上。
dialogue.pinyin: Guòle yí ge xiǎoshí, wǒ hái zài chē shang.
dialogue.english: An hour went by and I was still in the car.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 十点二十分，我到了机场。
dialogue.pinyin: Shí diǎn èrshí fēn, wǒ dàole jīchǎng.
dialogue.english: At 10:20 I got to the airport.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 妈妈说：“北京路上的车真多啊！”
dialogue.pinyin: Māma shuō: "Běijīng lù shang de chē zhēn duō a!"
dialogue.english: My mom said, "Beijing's roads really are full of cars!"

explanation.hanzi: 第5课的“还”（1）表示再加上一个东西或一个动作，意思是“也、另外”：我还想买一个杯子。这一课的“还”（2）放在形容词前面，说的是程度：一、“还＋不错/可以/好”表示“过得去、比较好”，不是非常好，可是也不差；二、“还＋很＋形容词”表示到现在，程度还是那么高，没有变：离机场还很远。
explanation.english:
In Lesson 5, 还 (1) adds something more: "also, in addition" (我还想买一个杯子 "I also want to buy a cup"). 还 (2) is different: it sits in front of an adjective and tells you about degree, i.e. how much of a quality there is.
(a) 还 + 不错 / 可以 / 好 means "fairly, reasonably, not bad": the speaker is satisfied, but not excited. 还不错 is weaker praise than 很好.
(b) 还 + 很 + adjective means the degree is "still" that high and hasn't changed yet: 离机场还很远 "the airport is still a long way off".
Quick test: if you can translate 还 as "also / in addition", it is 还 (1). If it describes how good, far, cold... something is, it is 还 (2).

title.english: The Adverb "就": Early, Quickly, As Soon As

explanation.hanzi: “就”放在动词前面，前面常常有一个时间词或者一段时间。它表示说话人觉得事情发生得早、快，或者时间短。句末常常有“了”。“动词＋了……就＋动词”表示前一个动作一完，后一个动作马上开始。
explanation.english:
就 goes right before the verb, usually after a time word (六点) or an amount of time (十分钟). It shows the speaker feels the action happens early, quickly, or after only a short time. A sentence about something that has happened usually ends in 了.
六点就起床了 = "got up as early as six"; 十分钟就到了 = "got there in just ten minutes".
With "verb + 了 ..., 就 + verb", 就 means "as soon as": the second action follows right after the first.

examples.hanzi: 我家离学校不远，走十分钟就到了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào bù yuǎn, zǒu shí fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
examples.english: My home isn't far from school; it's only a ten-minute walk.

examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān wǔ diǎn jiù qǐ chuáng le.
examples.english: He got up as early as five today.

examples.hanzi: 坐出租车，二十分钟就能到机场。
examples.pinyin: Zuò chūzūchē, èrshí fēnzhōng jiù néng dào jīchǎng.
examples.english: By taxi you can get to the airport in just twenty minutes.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ chīle fàn jiù qù gōngsī.
examples.english: I'll go to the office as soon as I've eaten.

explanation.hanzi: “A离B＋远/近”用来说两个地方之间的距离。A和B都是地方，否定形式是“A离B不远”。问的时候可以说“A离B远吗？”“A离B远不远？”或者“A离B多远？”。“离”也可以说时间：离考试还有三天。
explanation.english:
Use "A 离 B + 远 / 不远" to say how far place A is from place B. Both A and B are places (or people's homes). For questions say "A 离 B 远吗?", "A 离 B 远不远?" or "A 离 B 多远?" (how far?). The opposite of 远 is 近 jìn "near", which you will learn later.
离 can also measure time up to an event: 离考试还有三天 "there are three days left until the exam".

examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào bù yuǎn.
examples.english: My home isn't far from school.

examples.pinyin: Jīchǎng lí zhèr hěn yuǎn ma?
examples.english: Is the airport very far from here?

examples.hanzi: 你的公司离你家远不远？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de gōngsī lí nǐ jiā yuǎn bu yuǎn?
examples.english: Is your company far from your home?

examples.pinyin: Lí wǒ de shēngrì hái yǒu wǔ tiān.
examples.english: There are five days left until my birthday.

explanation.hanzi: 以前学过问句里的“呢”（你呢？）。“呢”也可以放在陈述句末尾：一、和“在”一起，表示动作正在进行，情况还在继续：他在睡觉呢。二、表示说话人在提醒对方一个事实，语气比较软，常常和“还”一起用：还很远呢、还早呢。
explanation.english:
You already know 呢 in questions (你呢? "and you?"). 呢 can also end a statement:
(a) Together with 在, it shows an action is in progress or a situation is still going on: 他在睡觉呢 "he's sleeping (right now)".
(b) It gently points out a fact to the listener, making the sentence sound softer and more conversational. It often goes with 还: 还很远呢 "it's still quite far, you know", 还早呢 "it's still early".

examples.pinyin: Wáng Míng zài jiàoshì kàn shū ne.
examples.english: Wang Ming is reading in the classroom.

examples.pinyin: Lí jīchǎng hái hěn yuǎn ne.
examples.english: The airport is still quite a long way off.

examples.hanzi: 现在还早呢，我们走路去吧。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài hái zǎo ne, wǒmen zǒu lù qù ba.
examples.english: It's still early, so let's walk there.

singleComponentChars.etymology: The oldest form shows a person swinging their arms in full stride, with a foot drawn underneath. The top part now looks like 土 and the bottom is a stretched-out foot.

radicals.english: step (related to walking, roads and actions)
tap, strike (a hand holding a stick; related to actions)
examples: 教 jiāo / jiào (to teach; as in 教室)

prompt.hanzi: 两人一组，谈谈你们怎么去不同的地方。
prompt.english: In pairs, talk about how you get to different places.

activities: Draw a quick map of your neighborhood. Ask and answer with 离: A: 你家离学校/商店/医院远吗？ B: 不远，走……分钟就到了。/ 很远，坐公共汽车要……
Taxi role play: one partner is a passenger in a hurry to get to the airport, the other is the driver. Use 还很远呢, 要……个小时 and 能快一点儿吗？
Tell your partner what time you got up and left home today, using 就 if it was early: 我六点就起床了。
Rate five things (your Chinese, the school canteen, the weather, a film...) with 很好 / 还不错 / 还可以 / 不太好.
